offer.journal: The engraving is worn past reading, but his service record lists family at the <Place>. Word travels fast. A curator wants the medal for his war room and will pay more than the family can. It's my call.
offer._journal: His play 2026-10-08: "the log doesn't read quite right, I think the family delivery one is skipped". The log shows only the NEWEST stage's line, and the driver sets 50 (the family line) and 60 (this one) in the same instant, so 50 is never seen. So this line carries both of Jessica's sentences, verbatim, family first; her "I should take it to them" is dropped as the one clause the choice contradicts. ⏳ Jessica's to reword as one line if she likes.
say: You're the one with the Colony War medal?
I keep a war room. People come to see what the war cost.
The family can't pay what I can. Come see me. Your call.
